Interactive Canvas Editor
|-- [M] Modular structure: workspace, semantic commands, native interaction
|   |-- Workspace composition: MappingPocPage / MappingWorkspacePage
|   |   |-- Supplies MappingServices; assembles CanvasWorkspace and command receivers
|   |   |-- Agent commands -> CanvasViewReceiver / DiagramRevisionReceiver / controller
|   |   |-- Persistence boundary -> WorkspacePersistence + WorkspaceStorage
|   |   `-- Each opened document -> MappingEditorCanvas + MappingPocSelectionCanvas
|   |       |-- Native shell supplies tldraw Editor and CanvasRuntimeContext
|   |       `-- Application UI supplies selection, pane, prompt and navigation actions
|   |-- Semantic command boundary: CanvasSession
|   |   |-- Exposes controller commands and read-only store interfaces
|   |   |   `-- document, presentation, selection, controls, geometry, status
|   |   |-- Private writable stores publish controller changes synchronously
|   |   `-- MappingDocumentController supplies semantic edits and checkpoint history
|   |       `-- Same command facade supports mounted editors and headless sessions
|   `-- Native rendering boundary
|       |-- MappingEditorRuntime bridges controller checkpoints and tldraw shapes
|       |-- CanvasRuntime exposes per-entity models, gestures and application callbacks
|       |-- projectMappingShapes converts semantic layout into native shape records
|       `-- NativeRoutingStore keeps routing geometry and worker scheduling internal
|-- [C] Interaction -> semantic checkpoint -> consumers
|   |-- Drag or resize
|   |   |-- tldraw changes live shapes; runtime marks geometry dirty
|   |   |-- Idle tick waits until pointing, dragging and pinching have stopped
|   |   `-- MappingEditorRuntime.settle()
|   |       |-- Compare native shapes with last projected shapes
|   |       |-- Diagram movement -> page coordinates -> rounded, nonnegative grid position
|   |       |-- Pane movement/resize -> display geometry and manual/fixed sizing policy
|   |       |-- Supported diagram clone -> duplicate-instance command
|   |       |   `-- Unsupported pane/group clones are removed
|   |       `-- Changed geometry -> controller.commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|   |-- Explicit selection gesture
|   |   |-- Node hit / completed marquee / whole-diagram selection
|   |   |   `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas -> controller.updateCanvas(..., true)
|   |   `-- Native drag selection stays separate from semantic content membership
|   |-- Controller publishes a changed snapshot
|   |   |-- CanvasSession updates affected focused stores
|   |   |-- New canvasRevisionId -> session commit listeners
|   |   |   `-- CanvasWorkspace -> change version + persistence notification(document ID)
|   |   |-- MappingEditorRuntime.publish() -> shape diff + mappingCheckpoint metadata
|   |   |   `-- Unchanged checkpoint while pointing -> defer projection
|   |   `-- CanvasRuntime.sync() -> per-grid, pane, side-panel and edge models
|   |       `-- Equal branches retain identity; unrelated models remain stable
|   |-- Undo / redo
|   |   |-- Complete native interaction -> settle outstanding geometry
|   |   |-- Ordinary navigation -> tldraw undo/redo
|   |   |   `-- Changed mappingCheckpoint -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint(id)
|   |   |       `-- Reproject semantic state without recording another undo step
|   |   `-- Cross-document transfer boundary -> workspace undo/redo
|   |       `-- Coordinate both document histories and the transfer record
|   `-- Camera movement
|       |-- Native camera -> overlay CSS transform
|       `-- Capture view camera + notify view-state callback
|           `-- Does not publish pointer/camera samples through semantic session stores
|-- [O] Responsibility and lifetime
|   |-- CanvasWorkspace owns document sessions
|   |   |-- Draft seed -> create CanvasSession + register controller and subscriptions
|   |   |-- Metadata updates retain the existing session
|   |   `-- Replace/remove draft -> unsubscribe, unregister controller, dispose old session
|   |       `-- Session clears cursor-copy state, controller subscription and commit listeners
|   |-- Mounted native editor owns live geometry and native undo navigation
|   |   |-- Controller retains semantic checkpoints for persistence/headless use
|   |   |-- Runtime startup replays checkpoint references; historical shapes materialize on navigation
|   |   `-- Editor cleanup -> complete and settle, detach driver/listeners, clear editor reference
|   |       `-- Clearing editor disposes routing worker and pending routing state
|   |-- SelectionState owns ordered membership and selection identity
|   |   |-- Captured regions store canonical content-node IDs and source content/ASCII
|   |   |-- Repeated equivalent regions reuse identity; reducer deduplicates by ID
|   |   `-- Focus, controls and retained selection panes have separate lifetimes
|   |-- DisplayState owns floating-pane hierarchy and presentation
|   |   |-- Selection roots retain context for projections, code panels and conversations
|   |   |-- Remove a display node -> recursively remove descendants and repair child references
|   |   |-- Collapse preserves expanded geometry for later restoration
|   |   `-- SourcePaneViewState owns live scrolling; pane scroll fields are saved checkpoints
|   `-- Page-level cleanup
|       |-- Dispose workspace, prompt coordinator, search service and view-state resources
|       |-- Internally created storage -> flush when available, then dispose
|       `-- In-flight local chat requests -> abort on canvas UI unmount
`-- [D] Data dependencies: what computed results require
    |-- Shared semantic input [S]
    |   `-- Controller snapshot: document + display + diagramViews + selection + cell metrics
    |-- Native shape projection
    |   |-- [S] document presentation scene + diagramViews -> resolved boxes
    |   |   `-- Grid bounds + cell metrics -> pixel positions, sizes and parent relationships
    |   |-- [S] display hierarchy + expansion + selection -> visible floating shapes
    |   `-- [S] document.edges -> arrow shapes; alternatives -> side-panel shapes
    |-- Render models and selected content
    |   |-- [S] diagram content + view + cell metrics -> grid model and layout key
    |   |-- Captured membership + matching content ID/ASCII -> selected canonical nodes
    |   |   |-- Current selections resolve explicit IDs in stored order
    |   |   |-- Legacy selections without IDs fall back to rectangle intersection
    |   |   `-- Mismatched content/ASCII -> no selected nodes
    |   `-- Display ancestry + source presence/content + view state -> pane visibility/staleness
    |-- Connection routing
    |   |-- [S] document.edges + resolved semantic anchors -> edge endpoint models
    |   |-- Diagram content/view/cell -> local obstacles
    |   |   `-- Matching measured layout replaces estimates; native transforms place obstacles
    |   |-- Endpoints + obstacles -> routed arrows
    |   |   |-- During dragging -> preview using prior settled routes
    |   |   |-- After dragging -> worker route request; preview while waiting
    |   |   |   `-- One job in flight + newest pending job; stale results are not published
    |   |   `-- No worker / worker failure -> synchronous router fallback
    |   `-- Camera changes are not routing dependencies; arrows are not a second persisted edge set
    |-- Mapped-source panel
    |   `-- Selected canonical nodes + diagram source mappings + project context
    |       `-- handleNodeSelect -> code-panel content attached to a retained selection
    `-- Dirty status and saving
        |-- Scene key vs saved scene key -> sceneDirty
        |-- sceneDirty OR changed edges OR changed name -> isDirty
        `-- Save captures document/name/version -> sync persistence -> flush -> publish checkpoint
            `-- Acknowledgement updates the captured baseline; later edits remain distinguishable
